text_block_list.text:
Pre-race interviews are being shown on
TV during
breaks in the coverage of the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I
can't
lose this race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my very best. Because,
well, I'm
going to win the spring Tenno
Sho!

The small screen shows a montage of
clips of the
racers training vigorously.

Mihono Bourbon, who has been fixated
on the
screen, suddenly stands up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have identified a surge in power within
me. A
strong "desire to win" has
overcome me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is unusual for me to be so mentally
stimulated
before a race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I'm anxious that this will
have an
effect on my performance. Your
advice, please,
Trainer.

I tell her that her feelings will give her
strength
and remind her to stay relaxed
while running.
choice_data_list: 『勝ちたい』気持ちはブルボンの味方だ
choice_data_list_en: Bourbon, your desire to win will be your greatest ally.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your simple and clear
explanation.
I now understand that my
reaction is a positive
one.

She settles down and quietly turns off
the TV.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I have nothing more to be
anxious
about. I will definitely be
victorious.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In particular, I won't lose to McQueen...
or Rice.

Mihono Bourbon looks straight ahead,
her eyes
burning with passion.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer. I'll be on my way.
